note: Every vector in v4.json that carries a public key (4-S-1, 4-S-2, 4-S-3, 4-F-1), each field copied unchanged. Left out: the secret-key, secret-key-seed, secret-key-pem and public-key-pem fields, since checking a token needs only the public key in hex, and every vector that carries a symmetric key instead (4-E-*, 4-F-2 to 4-F-5).
